title.zh: 速度与 v-t 图 · 面积就是路
title.en: Speed and the v–t Graph · Area Is Distance

desc.zh: 先看一场赛跑：位置—时间图像的陡缓就是快慢；换上速度—时间图像，看的是高低、不是陡缓；图像下方的面积，数出来正是走过的路——把加速段切成 4 条、8 条、16 条窄条，台阶和会一步步贴近真路程。
desc.en: Start with a race: on a position–time graph, steepness is speed. Switch to a velocity–time graph and you read height, not steepness — and the area under the graph counts out exactly the distance travelled. Slice the speeding-up stretch into 4, 8, 16 thin strips and watch the step sums close in on the true distance.
